label: Magerquark
note: Magerstufe, under 10 % fat in dry matter; made from skimmed milk, no cream

about.text: The lean grade of German quark, made from skimmed milk with no cream stirred in, so it holds under 10 % fat in dry matter. Like all quark it is about 80 % water, and the law asks for at least 73 % water in the fat-free mass.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

facts.v: Skimmed milk, no cream added; one tub is labelled 0.2 % fat
